source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: What does a connector contribute to an agent system?

options.text: A replacement for the model's learned parameters
options.feedback: An integration gives access to a resource; it does not replace the numerical parameters of the model.

options.text: A preferred answer learned during post-training
options.feedback: Post-training shapes behavior. A connector supplies a route to an external service or resource.

options.text: A self-contained set of grading criteria
options.feedback: Criteria belong in the task or reusable instructions. A connector provides an integration rather than those criteria.

options.text: An integration with a service or resource
options.feedback: A connector exposes an integration that an agent can use when the surrounding system permits it.
